name: Queens Climax
storyline: The story of Queens Climax begins on Princess Crystelle's 18th birthday in the Kingdom of Brighton. It was a celebration. However, little did the people know their time of happiness would be violently cut short. A discrete band of assassins infiltrated the unsuspecting castle and wiped out the entire royal family—except for one.
summary: Queens Climax is a beautiful or cruel 2D erotic visual novel where a kidnapped and enslaved princess, is thrown into a kingdom of darkness. Win the hearts of your enemies through seduction and escape or descend into the twisted grasp of your captor, Queen Renea!
